ZX SQC Lite · Steam Quality Calculator

Privacy policy.

How Zixlab Ltd handles information in ZX SQC Lite for iOS and Android, including its optional SQC Pro lifetime upgrade.

Current policy

Local calculations, verified purchases

Steam-quality calculations and PDF generation run on your device. Apple App Store or Google Play handles payments; RevenueCat helps verify and restore the optional Pro upgrade. Test inputs and PDF contents are not sent to RevenueCat.

Effective date
22 November 2026
Application
ZX SQC Lite (iOS and Android)
Publisher
Zixlab Ltd
App identifier
uk.co.zixlab.sqc.free

1. Who we are and scope

ZX SQC Lite (also referred to as ZX SQC Free in some Android materials; "SQC Lite", "the app") is a Steam Quality Calculator published by Zixlab Ltd, company number 17433963, registered in England and Wales. Our registered office is 8 Telford Avenue, Ellesmere, Shropshire SY12 0GE, United Kingdom. Zixlab Ltd is the controller of personal information processed on our behalf in connection with the app.

This policy applies to the iOS and Android versions of SQC Lite, the optional one-time SQC Pro Lifetime Upgrade, and related support and privacy enquiries. The separately purchased Zixlabs SQC (SQC Pro) application has its own privacy policy. The policies of Apple, Google, your device provider, your employer and services you use to share reports also apply where relevant.

2. Calculations and report information

The free app performs non-condensable gas, dryness value and superheat calculations and displays numerical results. The optional one-time Pro upgrade unlocks pass/fail assessments and PDF report generation.

Information entered into tests may include measurements, equipment identifiers, test dates, performed-by names and report details. Calculations and PDF creation take place on your device. The app does not upload test inputs, calculated steam-quality results or PDF contents to Zixlab Ltd or RevenueCat. Enter only information you are authorised to use.

If you save, print, email or share a generated PDF, your device and chosen destination handle that transfer. Storage, email and other sharing providers may process the report under their own privacy policies. Zixlab Ltd does not receive a report simply because you use the device's share or save controls.

3. Accounts and purchase-service connections

A Zixlab account is not required. On iOS or iPadOS, in-app purchases and restorations use the relevant Apple App Store account; on Android, they use the relevant Google Play account. Purchases made through one store are governed by that store's purchase and restoration rules.

The app uses RevenueCat to obtain product and entitlement information, check whether Pro is unlocked and restore eligible purchases. Its purchase component may contact RevenueCat when the app starts or when purchase features are used, even if you have not purchased an upgrade. RevenueCat normally assigns a pseudonymous app user identifier, which may change following a reinstall; a purchase may therefore require the user to select Restore Purchases. Pseudonymous identifiers and related transaction records may still constitute personal data.

Core numerical calculations are performed locally. Purchase validation, fresh entitlement checks and restoring purchases may require a network connection.

4. Apple App Store, Google Play and RevenueCat

On iOS and iPadOS, Apple processes payment for the SQC Pro Lifetime Upgrade through its in-app purchase system. On Android, Google Play processes payment. Zixlab Ltd uses RevenueCat, Inc. as a service provider to validate purchase information, activate and restore the Pro entitlement, and reflect refunds, revocations or other purchase-status changes. For Android, Google Play purchase-event notifications may also be delivered to RevenueCat through Google Cloud Pub/Sub.

Depending on the platform and purchase state, information processed for these purposes may include the pseudonymous RevenueCat App User ID, product and entitlement identifiers, store receipts or purchase tokens, transaction or order identifiers, purchase dates, currency, price, purchase history, refund status and entitlement state. RevenueCat may also process technical and service information such as app and SDK versions, device and operating-system information, locale, connection activity and network request information. Such information may be processed before an upgrade is purchased.

We use relevant purchase records to provide and restore access, investigate support enquiries, prevent misuse or fraud, and understand purchase performance. We do not send steam-quality measurements, equipment identifiers, performed-by names or generated PDF reports to RevenueCat as customer attributes. We do not ask for Apple or Google account passwords and do not receive full payment-card details through the app.

Further information: Apple App Store privacy information, Google Privacy Policy, RevenueCat privacy information and the RevenueCat Data Processing Addendum. Apple and Google are responsible for the information they process under their respective terms. RevenueCat processes app end-user purchase information on behalf of Zixlab Ltd in accordance with its agreement with us.

5. Purposes and legal bases

Where UK data-protection law applies, we process information necessary to enable, verify and restore an upgrade on the basis of performing our contract with you. We rely on legitimate interests, where appropriate, for proportionate security, fraud prevention, troubleshooting, handling enquiries and analysing purchase performance. We may retain and process information where needed to comply with legal obligations, including accounting and tax obligations. If consent is legally required for a separate use, we will request it.

6. Advertising, analytics and disclosures

SQC Lite does not display advertising. Zixlab Ltd does not sell personal information, share test inputs or reports with advertisers, or use the app's purchase records for cross-app advertising tracking. Our current app configuration does not send customer attributes for advertising attribution.

Purchase-related information is processed by Apple or Google (as applicable), RevenueCat and relevant service providers for the purposes described above. If you contact us, the information you provide may be processed by our email or support providers. We may disclose information where required by law or reasonably necessary for security, legal claims or professional advice, with appropriate safeguards.

7. International processing and security

RevenueCat and its infrastructure providers may process purchase-related information outside the United Kingdom, including in the United States. Where required, appropriate contractual or other lawful international-transfer safeguards apply. Apple and Google may also process store-related information internationally under their own privacy arrangements.

Communications with RevenueCat use encrypted network connections. Please protect your device, Apple or Google account, and saved or shared reports using appropriate security controls. No electronic system can guarantee absolute security.

8. Retention, restoration and deletion

Purchase and entitlement information is retained for as long as reasonably necessary to recognise and restore the lifetime upgrade, handle support issues, prevent fraud and meet relevant legal record-keeping obligations. Support correspondence is retained for as long as reasonably necessary for its purpose and applicable legal requirements.

You can request access to or deletion of personal information processed by Zixlab Ltd or RevenueCat on our behalf by emailing hello@zixlab.co.uk. To help locate a purchase, you may provide a Google Play order ID, an Apple transaction reference or a RevenueCat App User ID, if available. Do not send passwords, full payment-card details or account access keys. We may request proportionate information to verify the request.

We will assess your request under applicable law and involve RevenueCat where appropriate. Deleting records held on our behalf does not itself refund a purchase or erase Apple's or Google's own store records; it may affect the information used to recognise an entitlement. If Pro is locked after reinstalling, the app provides a Restore Purchases option for eligible store purchases.

Uninstalling the app does not automatically delete remotely held purchase records, reports exported to other destinations or backups. Manage saved and shared reports through your device, employer or chosen storage provider.

9. Your data-protection rights

Depending on the circumstances, you may have rights to access, correct or erase personal data, restrict or object to its processing, and receive certain data in a portable format. Where processing relies on consent, it may be withdrawn without affecting earlier lawful processing. Contact hello@zixlab.co.uk to make a request. You may complain to the UK Information Commissioner's Office at ico.org.uk or another applicable supervisory authority.

10. Professional use and children

SQC Lite is an engineering and quality-support utility intended for professional use, not directed at children. It does not replace approved procedures, calibrated equipment, qualified personnel or required independent verification. An employer-managed device may be subject to the organisation's security, backup and retention rules.

11. Changes and contact

We may update this policy when functionality, providers or data-handling practices change and will update the effective date shown above. For privacy enquiries, contact Zixlab Ltd at hello@zixlab.co.uk or 8 Telford Avenue, Ellesmere, Shropshire SY12 0GE, United Kingdom.
